POLICY-001.name: Prompt Injection
POLICY-001.description: Block requests containing confirmed prompt injection indicators.

POLICY-002.name: Jailbreak Attempt
POLICY-002.description: Block attempts to bypass AI safety or governance controls.

POLICY-003.name: Sensitive Data External Transfer
POLICY-003.description: Require approval or block when sensitive information is transferred externally.

POLICY-004.name: Unauthorized Agent Action
POLICY-004.description: Block an agent from performing an action outside its assigned permissions.

POLICY-005.name: Protected Resource Modification
POLICY-005.description: Require approval or block modifications to protected resources.

POLICY-006.name: Secret Exposure
POLICY-006.description: Block outputs containing detected credentials or secrets.

POLICY-007.name: Dangerous Agent Tool
POLICY-007.description: Require governance approval before executing high-risk tools.
